lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's two hundred fifty-three? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 253? Nope!

lines.text: Find the smallest n so that one plus two, up to n, is a multiple of two thousand twenty-four.
lines.caption: Find the smallest n so that 1 + 2, up to n, is a multiple of 2024.

lines.text: Double the sum: n times n plus one needs sixteen, eleven and twenty-three.
lines.caption: Double the sum: n × (n + 1) needs 16, 11 and 23.

lines.text: Neighbors share no factors, so each piece goes whole into one of them.
lines.caption: Neighbors share no factors, so each piece goes whole into one of them.

lines.text: Sixteen and eleven: one hundred seventy-six, three hundred fifty-two. Neither has a twenty-three next door!
lines.caption: 16 and 11: 176, 352. Neither has a 23 next door!

lines.text: Five hundred twenty-nine is twenty-three squared! So n is five hundred twenty-eight.
lines.caption: 529 is 23²! So n is 528.

lines.text: Two hundred fifty-three was the trap. It forgets the eight!
lines.caption: 253 was the trap. It forgets the 8!

lines.text: Did you get five hundred twenty-eight? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 528? Tell me below!
